entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: A species of sapient insect-folk, humanoid wasps known for communal organization and adaptability to multiple worlds; they spread by terraforming seedships.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: Sapient six-legged insectile beings of Ravnica's Undercity, loyal to Vraska personally after she became Golgari guildmaster.

entities.name: Nantuko
entities.description: A sapient race of mostly benevolent man-sized insects who respect nature and protected the Krosan Forest; Kamigawan nantuko are affiliated with the Order of Jukai.

entities.name: Speedbrood
entities.description: Insects and arthropods from an unknown, alien plane who fielded a racing team in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Radian Aatchik
entities.description: Leader of the Speedbrood racing team in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: An interplanar race across Avishkar, Amonkhet and Muraganda.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: A Dominarian Eumidian with a particularly powerful mind who broke free of the hive society to live independently.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who became Golgari guildmaster, after which the Kraul became loyal to her personally.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The black-green guild of Ravnica, whose members ride stiltstriders and among whom the Kraul live.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city where the Golgari Swarm and Kraul live in the Undercity.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who released a swarm of locusts.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane on which the Locust God released a swarm of locusts.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A region of Otaria home to the Nantuko, all but destroyed after the machinations of Karona, the Mirari and the time rifts.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A lord of Urborg whom Nantuko are said to serve in the Time Spiral novel.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: A planet in the Sothera system terraformed by Evendo-strain Eumidians, who turned its equator into lush forests.

entities.name: Pistus flies
entities.description: Mosquito-like insects of Mirrodin that now spread the Phyrexian contagion as unwitting allies of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Grotag
entities.description: A goblin tribe on Zendikar that has domesticated ventcrawlers.

entities.name: Thelonite Order
entities.description: An order in Sarpadia that included humanoid insects who may have been Nantuko.

events.summary: The Locust God releases a swarm of locusts on an unprepared Amonkhet.
events.quote: The Locust God released a swarm of locusts on an unprepared Amonkhet .

events.summary: Eumidian individuals with powerful minds, such as Xira Arien, break free of the hive society to live independently.
events.quote: individuals with particularly powerful minds, such as Xira Arien , were able to break free and live independently.

events.summary: Krosa is all but destroyed, leaving the fate of the Krosan Nantuko unknown.
events.quote: The current fate of the Krosan Nantuko is unknown, as Krosa has been all but destroyed after the machinations of Karona , the Mirari , and the time rifts.

events.summary: Pistus flies become unwitting allies of New Phyrexia by spreading the Phyrexian contagion.
events.quote: In recent times they've become an unwitting ally of New Phyrexia , as they are capable of slurping up and then spreading the Phyrexian contagion to other creatures.

events.summary: After Vraska becomes Golgari guildmaster, the Kraul gain a more important role and become loyal to her personally rather than to the Swarm.
events.quote: After Vraska became guildmaster , the Kraul gained a more important role and became loyal to her personally instead of to the Swarm.

events.summary: A Speedbrood racing team led by Radian Aatchik competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: A Speedbrood racing team led by Radian Aatchik competed in the Ghirapur Grand Prix across Avishkar , Amonkhet and Muraganda .

events.summary: Eumidians of the Evendo strain land on the planet Evendo and begin terraforming it.
events.quote: The Evendo-strain Eumidians are the specific strain of Eumidians that have landed on the planet Evendo , in the Sothera system .

relations.note: Nantuko in Urborg are said to serve Lord Windgrace in the Time Spiral novel.
relations.quote: In the Time Spiral novel , there are mentions of Nantukos still living in Urborg, and serving Lord Windgrace .

relations.note: The Kraul became loyal to Vraska personally.
relations.quote: After Vraska became guildmaster , the Kraul gained a more important role and became loyal to her personally instead of to the Swarm.

relations.note: The kraul inhabit the Undercity below Ravnica's streets.
relations.quote: The sapient kraul ( 17 cards ) inhabit the Undercity , far below the main streets of Ravnica .

relations.note: The Golgari Swarm is a guild of Ravnica whose members ride stiltstriders.
relations.quote: The Golgari Swarm of Ravnica ride bizarre insects called stiltstriders or longlegs , which are gangly, stilt-legged creatures as tall as a building.
